name: New Era
verdict: New Era (New Era Cap, LLC) is controlled by its founding Koch family, with ACON Investments holding a significant stake. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: controlled by the founding (Koch) family, led by fourth-generation CEO Chris Koch; ACON Investments holds a significant stake (Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2024-06-06). No state or state fund in the chain, and no qualifying human-rights finding against the company (Fair Labor Association member since 2003) → none. Official Cap of LIV Golf and all 13 teams (livgolf.com/partners) and a partner on every LIV team page; also an F1 supplier deal (Alpine, Williams).
